title: AnimatedSprite3D pointing to wrong textures from SpriteFrames
body:
### Tested versions

4.5 - Compatibility Pipeline
4.5.1 - Compatibility Pipeline

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9159) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 61.61 GiB memory

### Issue description

I tried my best to workaround the issue by force using an AutoSprite.gd script that just calls .play() on the Animated Sprite3D via _ready().  This worked on some AnimatedSprite3D objects, but this has stopped working for me with newer ones.

I don't understand why it's pointing to the wrong textures, it can clearly understand the size of the textures the pixels are just not updating.

What I don't know is if it's a Compatibility Pipeline issue, or Alferd Spritesheet Unpacker corrupting the files somehow


### Steps to reproduce

- Create an AnimatedSprite3D as the root of a scene, or as a child of another scene
- Import multiple textures (already split before import if they were on a sheet), using Alferd Spritesheet Unpacker 
- Create a SpriteFrames resource for those textures
- Place all frames into the default animation
- Assign the animation to the AnimatedSprite3D
- Try to click Play on the SpriteFrames tab to preview the animation.
- Misbehaviour is visible where the quad of the renderer does scale to the resolution of the target frame, but its pixels are from the time oldest of whatever frame was first added, as if the node's serialization is corrupted

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I cannot get this issue to generate on a fresh project, so here's what I was working on.  it's quite small.

The problem is in the scene hit_spark.tscn found in Scenes/Particles

You can demonstrate by playing debug_room.tscn and shooting the gun with LMB.  Notice how all particles are just resizing instead of changing textures.

[Blood-Gold-and-Lapis.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24295685/Blood-Gold-and-Lapis.zip)

Here's a video demonstrating the issue as well 
https://youtu.be/BYFsVWgoRnw
